app.name: {{appName}}
app.tagline: Scroll with curiosity. Leave with knowledge.

banner.offline: You're offline. Loaded lessons, saves and reviews still work.
banner.storage: This browser is blocking storage. You can explore, but your progress won't be saved.

onboarding.welcomeTitle: Learn something fascinating in two minutes.
onboarding.welcomeBody: Short, verifiable ideas, one at a time. No ads, no limits, no sign-up.
onboarding.noAccount: Your progress is saved on this device.
onboarding.interestsBody: Pick as many as you like. Pick none and you'll get a bit of everything.
onboarding.goalTitle: How do you want to learn?
onboarding.themeBody: You can change this later in You → Settings.

purpose.exploreHint: A variety of topics and quick discoveries.
purpose.deepHint: Follow whole trails on one subject.
purpose.rememberHint: More quizzes and reviews to make it stick.

feed.label: Lesson feed
feed.allMutedBody: Unmute at least one topic to see lessons here.

card.draftBadgeLabel: Preview, not reviewed yet: see sources and review

audio.noVoice: There's no {{language}} voice on this device. Install one in your system settings to listen to this lesson.

quiz.title: Quick quiz
quiz.incorrect: Not quite. The right answer is: {{answer}}
quiz.reviewScheduled: These questions come back tomorrow in the Review tab, so the idea sticks.
quiz.reviewOff: Reviews are turned off in settings.
quiz.none: This lesson has no questions yet.

deeper.title: Go deeper
deeper.endOfTrail: You’ve reached the end of this trail.

sources.title: Sources and review
sources.draftBody: This lesson is a demo draft. It hasn't been through source checking or human review yet. Sources for every claim will be added before it's published.
sources.generatedWith: Draft written with AI assistance ({{model}}), awaiting verification.

session.title: Nice work!
session.question: Quick recall check, or call it a day?
session.finishedBody: Your progress is saved. Come back whenever you like: your reviews will be waiting in the Review tab.

exhausted.title: You've explored everything here
exhausted.body: New trails arrive regularly. Meanwhile, how about a different topic?

explore.title: Explore
explore.subtitle: Topics, trails and everything there is to discover.
explore.noResultsBody: Try another word, or browse the topics below.

topic.appliesNextSession: Changes apply from your next feed session.
topic.allSeenBody: Every lesson in this topic has already been in your feed.

review.title: Review
review.subtitle: Remembering a few days later is what makes an idea stick.
review.lowPressure: It takes a minute. Getting one wrong helps you remember too.
review.emptyBody: Answer a lesson quiz in Discover and its questions come back here tomorrow.
review.caughtUpBody: No reviews today. The next ones appear here when it's time.
review.nextOn: Next review: {{date, datetime(day: numeric; month: long)}}
review.masteredNext: Mastered · review on {{date, datetime(day: numeric; month: long)}}
review.howItWorks: How it works: after a correct answer, a question comes back in 1 day, then 3, 7, 14, 30 and 60 days. A wrong answer brings it back the next day. Three correct reviews in a row count as “mastered”.

library.title: Library

empty.savedBody: Tap Save on any card to keep the lesson here.
empty.historyBody: Lessons you open show up here.
empty.completedBody: A lesson counts as completed when you read it properly or answer its quiz.

library.localNote: Your saved lessons stay on this device, no account needed.

you.title: You
you.subtitle: What you learned and remembered, not your screen time.
you.immediateHint: Answer a quiz to see your accuracy.
you.delayedHint: Appears once you review something learned at least 3 days ago.
you.recalled_zero: No ideas recalled days later yet
you.recalledHint: Counts when you get a review right at least 3 days after learning.
you.activeDays_zero: No learning days in the last 7 days
you.activeDays_one: {{count}} learning day in the last 7 days
you.activeDays_other: {{count}} learning days in the last 7 days
you.noStreakPressure: No streak to lose. A little learning, whenever you can, counts.
you.noActivity: Explore a few lessons and your progress by topic shows up here.
you.localNote: Your progress is saved only on this device. Clearing browser data erases it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Your progress, saved lessons and reviews stay the same in either language.
settings.reduceMotionHint: We also follow your system setting.
settings.sessionSizeHint: After this many, we pause gently. You can always keep going.
settings.interestsHint: Shown more often in the feed, with room for new things.
settings.voiceMissing: no voice installed on this device
settings.reviewOptInHint: Questions you answer come back at growing intervals.
settings.privacyBody: Without an account, everything stays on this device: preferences, progress, saved lessons and reviews. None of it is sent to any server.
settings.exportSoon: Export and import your data: coming soon.
settings.delete: Delete my data from this device
settings.deleteConfirmBody: This erases preferences, progress, saved lessons and reviews from this device. It can't be undone.
settings.contentPreview: This is a preview build. Lessons are demo drafts that haven't been through source checking or human review yet.
settings.contentReviewed: Every lesson has been source-checked and human-reviewed.

reviewPrompt.title: Time to remember
reviewPrompt.body_one: {{count}} question is waiting for you. Recalling a few days later is what makes an idea stick.
reviewPrompt.body_other: {{count}} questions are waiting for you. Recalling a few days later is what makes an idea stick.
